## Overview

Blacksmith, a startup that helps engineering teams test and validate code before it ships, has raised a $45 million Series B led by Peak XV Partners, valuing the company at $550 million, according to [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/12/blacksmiths-valuation-jumps-10x-to-550m-as-ai-coding-fuels-software-validation/). editor_notes.content_quality: Well-structured funding story with careful sourcing discipline: attributes every figure and quote to its specific source (TechCrunch interview vs. PR Newswire release) rather than blending them, and explicitly calls out the customer-count discrepancy between the two rather than picking one.
editor_notes.source_verification: Read both snapshots directly. source-0 (TechCrunch) confirms every figure and quote verbatim: the $550M valuation, $60M prior valuation, $10M Series A, $58.5M total funding, '5,000 customers... up from more than 700', the $10M ARR/10-employee/tens-of-millions-of-dollars/~30-employee figures, the $1M/year largest-customer detail, and the 'still a bottleneck' quote. source-1 (PR Newswire) confirms the 'diagnosing CI failures, autofixing them, and keeping pull requests green' quote, the founder names (Jayaprakash, Shah, Maru), the '6,000 companies... up from approximately 800' figures, the 5-10% week-over-week CI growth, the 'hundreds of thousands of cores' / 'order of magnitude' compute plans, and both Jayaprakash quotes ('Writing code has gotten dramatically easier...' and 'several times more pull requests...').
editor_notes.factual_accuracy: All specifics trace verbatim to their cited sources. The one genuine discrepancy in the underlying sources (customer count: TechCrunch's 5,000/700 vs. the press release's 6,000/800) is accurately preserved as a discrepancy in the article's 'What We Don't Know' section rather than silently reconciled or picked -- correct handling per the no-fabrication rule.
editor_notes.tone_assessment: Neutral; the Analysis section is framed as analysis and doesn't overstate the company's claims.
editor_notes.originality: Not a duplicate -- no prior Blacksmith coverage in the archive.
editor_notes.overall_assessment: Approve. Every quote and figure verified verbatim against both sources; the cross-source discrepancy is handled correctly by disclosure rather than fabricated reconciliation. No corrections needed.
